name: module-size-inventory
body: The decomposition review uses file length as a signal rather than a mandate: 32 first-party files exceed the ~400-line signal (excluding `vendor/` and `.md`), 22 exceed 1000 lines, and 12 exceed 2000. The longest root-crate files are `src/main.rs` (10,403 lines; production ends around line 2811), `src/plan_cmd.rs` (7,469), `src/layers.rs` (5,720), `src/splice.rs` (4,317), `src/ingest.rs` (4,000), `src/load.rs` (3,505), `src/project_cmd.rs` (2,986), `src/artifacts.rs` (2,300), `src/node_cmd.rs` (2,137), and `src/cache.rs` (2,022). Inline `#[cfg(test)] mod tests` carries ~675 test functions (142 unit, 8 int, 310 e2e) across 23 files; `src/main.rs`'s tests span lines 2822-10401, and `src/node_cmd.rs` is ~438 production against 1,697 test. The frontend crates carry the same signal: `src/structlib/src/main.rs` (2,617), `src/javalib/CallGraphBuilder.java` (2,034), `src/pylib/src/main.rs` (1,968), `src/cpplib/main.cpp` (1,745), `src/rustlib/src/main.rs` (1,715), `src/golib/main.go` (1,390), `src/csharplib/Program.cs` (1,201), and `src/tslib/scanner.ts` (1,053). The law applies repo-wide (root crate plus eight frontend crates).
